text.name: Petrocaribe
text.rules: Record "oil diplomacy". SAE spends 2 points on one action. At the end of this turn, LIO spends 1 point placing influence.
text.history: Venezuela founded Petrocaribe on 29 June 2005, offering Caribbean states oil on preferential terms; in November 2005 the US-backed Free Trade Area of the Americas stalled at the Mar del Plata summit.
